reasons.action: The only supplied reference is an audio track, which has no authority over what a figure does on screen; with no visual reference, action is left entirely to the request.
reasons.medium: The single reference is a background-music audio asset and cannot establish a visual rendering medium; the pinned medium decision already records a no-reference disposition, so the request governs medium.
reasons.wardrobe: An audio track supplies no observed clothing or accessories, and no visual reference exists to transfer wardrobe from; the request governs wardrobe.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference describes any illumination, so no observed lighting can be retained or overridden; lighting is governed by the request.
reasons.framing: An audio reference carries no camera composition, shot scale or viewpoint, and aspect ratio and duration are not framing instructions; framing falls to the request.
reasons.palette: The audio track offers no color or tonal information, and no visual reference exists to define a grade; palette is governed by the request.
